title: Start with what matters to you
description: Choose a city, budget, and property type, or save a listing reference to revisit and compare later.
searchDescription: Choose a city, neighborhood, and budget that work for you.
linkDescription: Save a listing source and reference number so you can revisit it and compare options.
demoNote: This section is illustrative. No search was sent and no listing was saved.
cityHint: Choose a city from the list to start your search.
searchUnavailableDescription: Review your selections, then search for properties.
referenceDescription: Keep the listing source and reference number in your saved properties for comparison.
experienceDescription: Search on your own, or let MADAR suggest properties that fit your day and budget.
normalDescription: Find properties by city, district, listing type, property type, price, and keywords.
smartDescription: Get personalized recommendations based on your housing preferences, important places, budget, and optional interests.
creditNotice: Running Smart Search may use account credits. It starts only when you press the button.
aiNotice: Recommendation explanations are AI-generated. Check listing details before making a decision.
authDescription: Sign in for property recommendations tailored to your budget, important places, and needs.
readyDescription: Your preferences are saved. Adjust them here if needed, then start Smart Search when you are ready.
completeDescription: Add the required information for tailored recommendations without leaving this page.
readyNow: Your required information is complete. You can start Smart Search.
formDescription: Save your changes here without leaving the search page.
saveNotConfirmed: The server has not confirmed Smart Search readiness yet. Review your details and try again.
budgetPeriodHint: Rent: annual budget. Purchase: total price.
chooseLocation: Choose a location on the map or enter coordinates.
invalidLocation: Enter latitude from -90 to 90 and longitude from -180 to 180.
interestsOptional: Interests are optional and can be changed later.
